# Overview

source: 6ceb000

## What this is

`acme-tool` (package.json, v0.3.0) is a Node ES-module package that installs a single binary, `acme`, mapped to `src/cli/main.js` (package.json `bin`). The kit's classifier found evidence for two archetypes — `cli` (a `bin` entry) and `service` (an `express` dependency) — and could not resolve which one describes the system; see interview question `kind-ambiguous`. Reading the code (below) favors `cli`: `express` is imported and passed around, but nothing in the tracked source ever calls `.listen()` or registers a route (`reference/api.md` shows 0 route literals, `reference/ui.md` shows 0 UI routes).

## Parts

Three folded components (`reference/components.md`):

| component | files | what's there |
|---|---|---|
| `cli` | 1 | `src/cli/main.js` — the `acme` entry point |
| `core` | 2 | `src/core/run.js`, `src/core/back.js` |
| `web` | 1 | `src/web/server.js` |

## How they talk

Import edges (`reference/components.md`, `reference/drift.md`):

- `cli -> core`: `src/cli/main.js` imports `run` from `src/core/run.js` and calls it directly.
- `cli -> web`: `src/cli/main.js` imports `serve` from `src/web/server.js` and calls `serve(express)`.
- `web -> core`: `src/web/server.js` imports `run` from `src/core/run.js`; `serve(app)` ignores its `app` argument entirely and just calls `run()`.
- `core -> web`: `src/core/back.js` imports `serve` from `src/web/server.js` and re-exports it as `back`. **Nothing in the tracked source imports `src/core/back.js`** (confirmed by search) — it is currently dead code, and it is also the edge that closes the `core <-> web` import cycle flagged by `reference/drift.md` and gap `import-cycle-core-web`.

`src/core/run.js` is a one-line stub: `export const run = () => 1;` — it has no side effects and no logic beyond returning a constant.

Net effect of running `acme`: `src/cli/main.js` calls `run()` once directly, then calls `serve(express)`, which calls `run()` again through `src/web/server.js`. No HTTP server is ever started, no output is produced beyond the process exiting. GAP: no way to distinguish an intentional stub from unfinished work from the code alone.

## Configuration and secrets

`src/web/server.js` reads `process.env.ACME_API_TOKEN` into a local binding, `token`, on module load. It is read but never used elsewhere in the tracked source (`reference/env.md` — 1 site, flagged `secretLike`). See `architecture/secrets.md`.

## Dependencies

`reference/deps.md`: `express` (^4.19.0, imported by `src/cli/main.js`) and `leftpad` (^1.3.0, declared, no production import site found anywhere in `src/`). No lockfile is checked in.

## Delivery

One GitHub Actions workflow, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: job `test` on `ubuntu-latest`, one step, runs on every `push`. See `architecture/risks.md` — `package.json` defines no `scripts.test`, so this step has no script to run.

## Context

GAP: the context view could not be rendered — the LikeC4 renderer needs `npx`, which needs network access, and the sandbox this run executed in denied outbound network calls to registry npmjs org. No PNG exists under `docs/reference/views` for this run. See `_run/kit-issues.md`. The context edges the kit seeded from evidence in the checkout are, in `architecture/model/hand.c4`: a human operator uses the system; the system reads/writes GitHub (the CI workflow); the system reads/writes a workspace; the system writes a log. GAP: no code in `src/` reads or writes a log or a workspace directory — these are house-style defaults seeded by the kit's classifier, not something this review found evidenced in `src/`; see `_run/kit-issues.md`.

## Tests

`reference/tests-by-seam.md`: 0 test files found anywhere in the repository.

## Open questions

See `architecture/_run/interview.md` for the operator decisions this review could not make on its own: which archetype this is, what to do about the `core <-> web` cycle, and whether the unused `leftpad` dependency should be removed.
